title: "REDCap Cloud and CDISC ODM"
description: "Studies from REDCap Cloud or any EDC that exports CDISC ODM."
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
# Executed chunks are wrapped so the site can run them in the browser with webR.
knitr::knit_hooks$set(webr = function(before, options) if (before) "\n<div class=\"webr-chunk\">\n" else "\n</div>\n")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", webr = TRUE)
```

The engine does not depend on REDCap: anything that produces **CDISC ODM
1.3** works. That covers REDCap Cloud (nPhase), OpenClinica, Medidata Rave,
Castor and REDCap itself.

## Any EDC: an ODM file

```{r}
library(REDCapCDMSTAT)
demo <- cdmstat_demo(dir = file.path(tempdir(), "odm-src"), reset = TRUE)
f <- file.path(tempdir(), "study.odm.xml")
write_odm(demo$backend$state(), f)                 # stand-in for your EDC's export

nx <- cdmstat_odm(f, dir = file.path(tempdir(), "odm-study"))
nx$summary()[c("source", "records", "fields", "events")]
head(nx$validate()[, c("rule", "record_id", "value")], 4)
```

When you replace the file with a newer export, `nx$sync()` updates only the
subjects whose data changed. Subjects are compared by hash, because ODM
snapshots carry no change log:

```{r}
x <- readLines(f)
x[grep('I.weight" Value="450"', x)] <- sub("450", "81.0", x[grep('I.weight" Value="450"', x)])
writeLines(x, f)
nx$sync()[c("mode", "changed")]
```

How ODM maps to the engine:

| ODM | Engine |
|---|---|
| `StudyEventDef` | events (with `DayOffset` for visit windows) |
| `FormDef` with `Repeating="Yes"` | repeating instruments |
| `ItemDef` `DataType` | number, integer and date validation |
| `CodeList` | radio choices |
| `RangeCheck` | validation min / max |
| `Mandatory="Yes"` | required field |
| `SubjectKey` | record ID |

REDCap's own `redcap:` ODM attributes (field type, branching logic,
calculations) are honoured, so a REDCap → ODM → CDMSTAT round trip is
lossless.

## REDCap Cloud over its REST API

REDCap Cloud documents its REST API inside each customer account, not
publicly. That's why the endpoint paths and the authentication header are
settings:

```r
Sys.setenv(REDCAP_CLOUD_TOKEN = "...")      # or keyring_service =
nx <- cdmstat_cloud(
  base_url    = "https://<your-instance>.redcapcloud.com",
  study       = "TRIAL-7",
  export_path = "<ODM export path from your REDCap Cloud API documentation>",  # {study} is substituted
  import_path = NULL,                       # set it to enable write-back
  auth_header = "Authorization", auth_prefix = "Bearer "
)
```

The connector is tested against a mock server that enforces the token and
the path. Confirm the real paths in your REDCap Cloud documentation before
relying on it.

## Which features work where

| Feature | REDCap | REDCap Cloud / ODM |
|---|---|---|
| Sync, validation, queries, statistics, cuts, CDISC export | yes | yes |
| Incremental sync | from the REDCap log | by subject hash |
| Data Entry Trigger | yes | no |
| Queries in the EDC's own query system | with the DRW module | no (kept in CDMSTAT) |
| Form locks enforced in the EDC | with the DRW module | no (changes after a lock are flagged) |
| Write-back | API import | ODM import, if `import_path` is set |
